correctness.rationale: The dual polytope is given by explicit coordinate inequalities; its 14 potential generators and the primal 12 molecules yield an exact state formula for numerical radius. The universal norm bound follows by cases and a checked four-state functional identity. An explicit 3-by-3 operator has all 48 supported potential/molecule pairings in a rational list bounded by 1 for q in [0,1], and achieves norm R. Both endpoints and the continuous parameter interval are covered analytically.

value.rationale: Determines the natural numerical index across the entire real one-parameter family of three-dimensional Lipschitz-free spaces over a four-point star, the first higher-dimensional symmetric case beyond the three-point calculation. Strict interpolation and an explicit norming operator are mathematically meaningful and not obtained from the same family’s known Hilbert distortion.
